_comment: A sample is charged to the source file of its innermost engine frame: inlined
library frames (libc++ headers) are skipped outward, and a sample with no engine
frame is runtime. Files, not function names, decide the region, so a rename
cannot leave a stale marker; test_profile_regions.py fails when a file in src/
or external/fathom/src/ is not listed here.
min_inline_share: the profile is refused unless at least this share of in-module
samples carries an inline chain (two or more frames); a symbolizer or binary
without inline records reports one frame everywhere, and library frames could
then not be skipped to their engine caller. max_unresolved_share: refused when more
in-module samples than this have no function name. min_engine_share: refused when
fewer in-module samples than this resolve to an engine source file, as in a
build without line tables, whose every sample would be runtime.
